head: ṣʕr (< MEA ṣʕr (Pa.) cf. SL 1296: to insult, abuse;)

examples.raw: mṣaʕálle-le l-u=abro ʻer scholt den Sohn ausʼ; 243; prs 213/13;

examples.turoyo: hano u=sobo ko-mšayəl u=ṭaboxo ʕal u=dayroyo naʕimo w-ko-mṣaʕal-le
examples.translation: this old [monk] asked the cook about the young monk and abused him
examples.raw: hano u=sobo ko-mšayəl u=ṭaboxo ʕal u=dayroyo naʕimo w-ko-mṣaʕal-le ʻthis old [monk] asked the cook about the young monk and abused himʼ; 246; 42/4, 5;

examples.turoyo: b-u=ḥal-ano hənnək ku-mṣaʕri l-ḥḏoḏe, u=ṭaboxo ko-mbalaġ-ġe šlome
examples.translation: Thus, they would abuse each other [and] the cook would send them regards
examples.raw: b-u=ḥal-ano hənnək ku-mṣaʕri l-ḥḏoḏe, u=ṭaboxo ko-mbalaġ-ġe šlome ‘Thus, they would abuse each other [and] the cook would send them regards’; 42/8;

examples.turoyo: fayəš ko-mṣaʕro l-ruḥa w-l-i=saʕa d-ḥzela eba u=kačalōk
examples.translation: She began to scold herself and the hour when she had seen the bald-headed
examples.raw: fayəš ko-mṣaʕro l-ruḥa w-l-i=saʕa d-ḥzela eba u=kačalōk ‘She began to scold herself and the hour when she had seen the bald-headed’; 44/115

examples.turoyo: i=naqqa d-marfan-wo aq=qarqure qum d-a=ʕwone, u=qarqur-ano mṣaʕar-wo
examples.translation: wenn sie die Lämmer zu den Mutterschafen liessen, schimpfte dieses Lamm immer
examples.raw: i=naqqa d-marfan-wo aq=qarqure qum d-a=ʕwone, u=qarqur-ano mṣaʕar-wo ʻwenn sie die Lämmer zu den Mutterschafen liessen, schimpfte dieses Lamm immerʼ; 59/88;

examples.translation: es ist unmöglich. Sie würde meinen Vater nicht beschimpfen
examples.raw: ənkān layto. lə=ko-mṣaʕro-wa l-babi ʻes ist unmöglich. Sie würde meinen Vater nicht beschimpfenʼ; 64/52;

examples.turoyo: gəd-oṯe l-gabi me-darbe d-ono əzzí l-gabe, w-bəṯṯər m-aqqa ṣ=ṣurʕ-anək d-mṣaʕár-wayno-le
examples.translation: He will come to me instead of me coming to him after those insults with which I used to abuse him
examples.raw: gəd-oṯe l-gabi me-darbe d-ono əzzí l-gabe, w-bəṯṯər m-aqqa ṣ=ṣurʕ-anək d-mṣaʕár-wayno-le ‘He will come to me instead of me coming to him after those insults with which I used to abuse him’; 42/14

examples.turoyo: Zax w itax ḥeḏorayye, mbasamme w ṣaʕar elan, balki ṭəlbilax. :
examples.translation: Go and come around them, try to please them and swear at us, maybe they will ask you in marriage.
examples.raw:
Zax w itax ḥeḏorayye, mbasamme w ṣaʕar elan, balki ṭəlbilax. : "Go and come around them, try to please them and swear at us, maybe they will ask you in marriage."
 NE_Dilo_and_Falako;07
